Use pimpleFoam for a transient, incompressible, laminar simulation of flow past a cylinder in 2D.
Create the mesh one cell thick in the spanwise direction.
In constant/polyMesh/boundary, set the frontAndBack patch type to empty.
In 0/U, set the frontAndBack patch boundary condition to type empty.
Do not use type wall for frontAndBack in either file.
Do not mix patch types between the two files; both must use empty.
Set inlet boundary condition in 0/U to fixedValue with uniform velocity (Ux 0 0).
Set outlet boundary condition in 0/U to zeroGradient.
Set cylinderWall boundary condition in 0/U to noSlip.
Keep all other boundary and initial conditions consistent with a standard flow-past-cylinder pimpleFoam case.
